Nepal Floods and Landslides Cause Widespread Destruction

Heavy monsoon rains have triggered severe floods and landslides across Nepal, resulting in at least 24 reported deaths. The disaster has caused widespread destruction, with videos showing the extent of the devastation. The events in Nepal offer lessons for South Asia regarding disaster preparedness and response.
